problem_statement: When a record querier is started with a non-empty first label but a NULL second-labels field (which the public API documents as allowed when there are no other labels), an incoming DNS response for that first label is not matched against the already-cached entry whose second labels are set, so the querier never receives the record that should match it. The match must succeed for a NULL second-labels querier when the first label and record type match.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
